paper_title: FreqKV Frequency Domain Key-Value Compression for Efficient Context   Window Extension
caption: : Perplexity evaluation on the validation set of PG-19 with different retaining ratios.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between evaluation context length and PPL, with three different lines representing different gamma values. The x-axis is labeled "Evaluation Context Length" and uses an exponential scale with values ranging from 2K to 64K. The y-axis is labeled "PPL" and uses a linear scale, with values ranging from 7.7 to 8.2, marked at intervals of 0.1. The blue line, indicating γ=0.25, begins at approximately 8.2 at 2K and decreases to around 7.82 at 8K before showing minor fluctuations and stabilizing towards 64K at a value slightly below 7.8. The orange line, representing γ=0.5, starts at about 8.2 at 2K, drops to roughly 7.76 at 8K, and remains relatively steady through to 64K, finishing at approximately 7.72. The green line for γ=0.75 follows a similar pattern, beginning at about 8.2 at 2K and decreasing to around 7.74 by 8K, maintaining this level to 64K. All lines have circular markers with solid styles. The three lines overlap between 2K and 4K, and the green line intersects the orange line between 8K and 16K. A legend is there at the top right of the line plot to match different lines to their labels.
